What is the strangest thing that has ever happened to you?

A long time ago, I'd woken up in the middle of the night because I had vertigo. As I sat on my bed sipping water and clearing my head, I noticed lights from beyond my window's blinds. Not just headlights, they were flashing lights of different colors, but I don't remember noise or sirens or anything.

I peeked through the blinds, looking at our neighbor's house across the street. An ambulance was in their driveway and a firetruck was parked along the street, lights flashing brightly. I opened the blinds slightly so I could sit and watch the events unfolding from my bed. Eventually, two paramedics pulled a stretcher out of the ambulance, went in the front door, and after a little while, they came out with a body. They loaded the ambulance, and it drove off along with the firetruck.

It was good entertainment while I sat there recovering, but it was all very surreal, probably because it was like two in the morning and I was tired. When I asked my housemates about it in the morning, no one had any idea that anything happened. They never heard sirens or saw lights, I guess they slept through it. Maybe my tale was boring, but it was kinda strange to me because it seemed like I'd randomly woken up and had a dizzy spell right as someone across the street was dying (I can't say for sure if they really died, but I don't remember seeing that person ever again.
